metadata.case_name: FUNG WING YEE v. CHEN JUNG CHIEN

injuries.description: 2 cm diameter perinephric haematoma of the right kidney, which subsequently healed with conservative treatment.
source: CT of the abdomen on the same day revealed a 2 cm diameter perinephric haematoma of the right kidney, which subsequently healed with conservative treatment.

injuries.description: compound fracture of the right tibia and fibula
source: (c) fracture of the right tibia and fibula.
Orthopaedically, the plaintiff sustained a 15 cm open wound over her right leg and x-ray showed compound fracture of the right tibia and fibula.

injuries.description: 15 cm open wound over her right leg (surgical/graft wounds)
source: Orthopaedically, the plaintiff sustained a 15 cm open wound over her right leg and x-ray showed compound fracture of the right tibia and fibula.
The examination revealed scars on her occipital region of her scalp and both her legs including surgical/graft scars.

injuries.description: non-union of the right tibia fracture
source: The compound fracture injury to her right leg was complicated by non-union and also post-traumatic flexion contracture of the right toes which did not respond to physiotherapy.

injuries.description: post-traumatic flexion contracture of the right toes which did not respond to physiotherapy
source: The compound fracture injury to her right leg was complicated by non-union and also post-traumatic flexion contracture of the right toes which did not respond to physiotherapy.
injuries.icd_description: Injury of unspecified muscle, fascia or tendon at ankle or foot level

injuries.description: permanent scars on occipital region of scalp and both legs including surgical/graft scars (depressed skin graft scar on right calf; scar on side of right knee)
source: The examination revealed scars on her occipital region of her scalp and both her legs including surgical/graft scars.
Two very noticeable and ugly scars stand out among them, being one on the side of her right knee and another at the rear of her right calf which is a depressed skin graft scar.
injuries.icd_description: Other specified injuries to the knee or lower leg

injuries.description: alopecia (loss of hair) on the scalp
source: Plastic surgery was also recommended for the alopecia (loss of hair) on the scalp.

manifestations.description: Glasgow Coma Scale dropped to 7/15 soon after admission
once or twice monthly occasional headaches at the right temple region lasting some 10 to 15 minutes
absent-mindedness akin to mild post concussional syndrome
ankle extension and eversion were reduced
occasional slight limp when walking; needed to rest after 1-2 hours
contractures in the toes causing difficulty wearing leather shoes
difficulty using right foot on the piano pedal affecting piano playing
superficial wound infection over the proximal wound after operation in March 2007
permanent and obvious scars on scalp and legs
alopecia (loss of hair) on the scalp

treatments_received: Emergency craniotomy and intracranial pressure monitoring
Debridement of right leg wound (5 Feb 2006)
External fixator applied to right leg (9 Feb 2006)
Skin grafting for right leg wound (14 Feb 2006)
Bone grafting to promote bone healing (13 Mar 2006)
External fixator removed (6 Jul 2006); use of sarimentio brace for walking
Close reduction and intra-medullary nail to the right tibia and Z-lengthening of flexor tendon of right foot (operation on 5 Mar 2007)
Course of antibiotics and removal of the proximal locking screw (7 Jun 2007)
Removal of tibial nail and tendon lengthening surgery of the right foot (16-20 Mar 2008)
Out-patient follow up and physiotherapy on a weekly basis
treatments_future: Possibility of a further operation to deal with the toes contracture (indicated to be in August after the School Certificate Examination)

losses.category: Loss of ability to engage in sports and hobbies
losses.description: Unable to play rugby or participate in physical education classes as before; only limited participation in PE; long-term reduction in sports activities.

losses.category: Loss of ability to engage in sports and hobbies
losses.description: Piano playing adversely affected due to inability to use right foot effectively on the piano pedal; delayed progression in piano grades and temporary cessation of lessons.

Permanent and obvious scars on scalp and right leg, including a depressed skin graft scar on the right calf and a scar on the side of the right knee; alopecia on scalp; disfigurement likely permanent and obvious.
Dependence on wheelchair for more than a year and on crutches thereafter; difficulty walking unaided for a prolonged period.
Required substantial assistance from mother for bathing, toilet and daily living during hospitalization and recovery period.

losses.category: Loss of ability to pursue education
losses.description: Disruption to schooling leading to failure to retain place in Elite class and inability to enter Science stream in Form 4, thereby jeopardizing prospects of university education and lost chance of becoming a doctor.
Could not go out with friends as before during recovery; reduced social outings and activities.
Scars may affect prospects of finding a partner in life or getting married.
